integrity: Analytic proof of universal association and sharp non-FKG obstruction; finite exact rational enumeration supports formulas but is not an infinite proof. No assertion of independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple graphs, independent one-attempt site proposals, observation times \(0\le t\le1\); no claim for repeated attempts or correlated clocks. Three-vertex FKG failure requires \(0<p<1\) and \(0<t\le1\). A full priority survey and independent validation remain outstanding.
title: Positive association without the lattice-FKG property in one-attempt antagonistic adsorption
